moi.core: Language of document != language of instruction; partial EMI courses != degree-wide MOI; MOI != CEFR ability score; acceptable document type != individual approval.
moi.case_a: Hypothetical still-enrolled student with three English-taught courses cannot assert whole-program English. Ask authorized issuer and recipient; retain unknown. No implied current NTHU entitlement.
moi.case_b: Hypothetical signed-template path: verify scheme, authorized coordinator and evidence; issue/submit/receive/adjudicate distinct. No merger of A evidence into B approval.
moi.source_limit: NTHU service scope contrasted with current TUM application requirements. No universal waiver, quoted fees, processing-day/calendar calculations, fabricated signatures or self-assessed language levels.
moi.inquiries: Two fill-in inquiries authored, not sent. No official template text rebranded as personal issued document.

phone.authorship: Two original cards, alternative transfer/unavailable paths, original caller dialogue, third-person notes, weak-to-revised message, three fill-in prompts, human checklist and delayed review. No actual model/audio benchmark.

card_b.question: Can a digital portfolio be used?

phone.states: Will put through != connected/answered. Will pass on != target has read. Reply request != accepted deadline. Whether-to-bring question != instruction to bring.
phone.bad_feedback: Invented today, return call rather than email, and instruction rather than question are rejected; hypothetical error is editorial, not attributed to an actual brand.
phone.evidence: Text addresses content/turn-taking, recording needed for sound. BC transcript actually read, audio not played. Task layers not CEFR certification.
phone.privacy: Fictional names/activities and example.com addresses; no genuine phone number, credential or message shared or sent.

arithmetic: No fees, score, credit or deadline arithmetic. Three courses in A is an explicit hypothetical count, not a language-equivalence calculation.
review_scope: Source-based editorial logic check; no external expert/student or empirical model outcome claimed.
